name: turn-lens
description: TurnLens: per-turn and session statistics for the current ZCode session (turns, steps, model time, tool time, TTFT, TPS, user-input and context tokens, requests, tool errors), on demand, after each turn, and in a live themed side panel.

description_i18n.en: TurnLens: per-turn and session statistics for the current ZCode session (turns, steps, model time, tool time, TTFT, TPS, user-input and context tokens, requests, tool errors), on demand, after each turn, and in a live themed side panel.
description_i18n.zh-CN: TurnLens：在会话中展示当前 ZCode 会话的单轮与累计统计（轮数、步数、模型用时、工具调用用时、TTFT、TPS、用户输入与上下文 tokens、主轮请求与工具错误），支持按需查看、每轮结束自动展示，以及适配主题的侧栏实时面板。
